scenes.narration: Press Option-Space, type a few letters, and press Return.
Ask a question, and it shows the passage and the page. It matches the words you use.
Clipboard history keeps what you copy.
It is off until you turn it on, and it skips password managers.
Nine ninety-nine, once, with a seven day free trial.
